article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 16 Master Broadcasts Dated Across AFRS Personal Album and Melody Roundup
article-meta.kwd-group: AFRS, Personal Album, Lena Horne, Anita ODay, Mel Torme, Roy Rogers, Bob Wills, Western Swing, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 26 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 26 resolves 16 wartime Armed Forces Radio Service (AFRS) master transcription recordings: 9 star-studded editions of ***Personal Album*** (beamed to Allied troops across Chungking, Casablanca, and the Pacific featuring Lena Horne with Cpl. Harry Geller, Anita O'Day, Mel Tormé, and Ginny Simms), alongside 7 rollicking western variety broadcasts of ***Melody Roundup*** (headlining Roy Rogers, Bob Wills and His Texas Playboys, Sons of the Pioneers, and Lum & Abner).

sec.title: 1. *AFRS Personal Album* — 1944–1947 Hollywood Master Discs Dated
sec.p: 15-minute intimate musical packages pressed for overseas military broadcast:
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Title | Verified Airdate | Vocalist & Musical Highlights | |---|---|---|---| | `Personal_Album_Lena_Horne.mp3` | **"AFRS Personal Album: Lena Horne with Cpl. Harry Geller Combo"** | **1944-08-15** | Lena Horne sings *I Can't Believe That You're in Love with Me* with soldier jazz accompaniment. | | `Personal_Album_Anita_ODay_Blue_Skies.mp3` | **"AFRS Personal Album: Anita O'Day ('Blue Skies')"** | **1944-11-28** | Jazz icon Anita O'Day's swing vocals and warm greetings to Allied soldiers. | | `Personal_Album_Ginny_Simms_Positive.mp3` | **"AFRS Personal Album: Ginny Simms & Cookie Fairchild ('Ac-Cent-Tchu-Ate the Positive')"** | **1945-01-23** | Johnny Mercer's optimistic wartime hit performed by Ginny Simms. | | `Personal_Album_Ginny_Simms_Too_Much_Love.mp3` | **"AFRS Personal Album: Ginny Simms ('Too Much in Love')"** | **1945-02-27** | Romantic ballad dedication to servicemen overseas. | | `Personal_Album_Phil_Regan.mp3` | **"AFRS Personal Album: Phil Regan (Songs for the United Nations Fighting Men)"** | **1944-09-12** | Tenor Phil Regan performs favorite requests beamed worldwide. | | `Personal_Album_Georgia_Gibbs.mp3` | **"AFRS Personal Album: Georgia Gibbs (GI News Gal of the Air)"** | **1944-10-31** | Georgia Gibbs shares GI news items and upbeat jazz vocals. | | `Personal_Album_Joe_Graydon.mp3` | **"AFRS Personal Album: Joe Graydon ('Sunday Best')"** | **1945-04-17** | Joe Graydon returns for a popular repeat performance. | | `Personal_Album_Mel_Torme_1166.mp3` | **"AFRS Personal Album 1166: Mel Tormé ('Open the Door, Richard!')"** | **1947-02-18** | 'The Velvet Fog' Mel Tormé riffs on the 1947 novelty sensation. | | `Personal_Album_Andy_Williams.mp3` | **"AFRS Personal Album: Andy Williams & The Little Sisters"** | **1946-06-25** | Early post-war radio vocal harmonies with young Andy Williams. |

sec.title: 2. *AFRS Melody Roundup* — 1944–1945 Western Swing Master Discs
sec.p: Recorded at the AFRS Los Angeles studios to bring the spirit of the American frontier overseas:
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Title | Verified Airdate | Western Performers | |---|---|---|---| | `Melody_Roundup_Roy_Rogers.mp3` | **"AFRS Melody Roundup: Roy Rogers, King of the Cowboys"** | **1944-06-15** | Roy Rogers and the Sons of the Pioneers with western trail songs. | | `Melody_Roundup_Bob_Wills_Right_Wrong.mp3` | **"AFRS Melody Roundup: Bob Wills and His Texas Playboys ('Right or Wrong')"** | **1944-08-10** | The King of Western Swing Bob Wills and his hot fiddle breakdown. | | `Melody_Roundup_Sons_Of_Pioneers_Lum_Abner.mp3` | **"AFRS Melody Roundup: Sons of the Pioneers (Hosted by Lum & Abner)"** | **1944-09-21** | Pine Ridge comedy legends Lum & Abner host the Sons of the Pioneers. | | `Melody_Roundup_Riders_Purple_Sage_Ragtime.mp3` | **"AFRS Melody Roundup: Riders of the Purple Sage ('Ragtime Cowboy Joe')"** | **1944-10-19** | Upbeat swing harmonies and acoustic guitar rhythms. | | `Melody_Roundup_Andy_Devine_Dont_Fence_Me.mp3` | **"AFRS Melody Roundup: Terry Bappkin Band & Andy Devine ('Don't Fence Me In')"** | **1944-12-07** | Gravel-voiced movie sidekick Andy Devine joins the band for Cole Porter's hit. | | `Melody_Roundup_Following_Sun_All_Day.mp3` | **"AFRS Melody Roundup: Riders of the Purple Sage ('Following the Sun All Day')"** | **1945-02-15** | Classic cowboy riding songs and prairie laments. | | `Melody_Roundup_Saddle_Serenade_Trio.mp3` | **"AFRS Melody Roundup: Saddle Serenade Trio (Western Swing Roundup)"** | **1945-03-22** | Fast-paced acoustic trio harmonies for armed forces listeners. |
